description: Sends one report's content as text (CSV, tab-separated or plain text, up to 4 MB) — read a PDF or spreadsheet first and send its rows. Guest Logic reads it and sets up what it can (rooms, room types, rates, taxes, stays). Returns what was found. Needs the owner's sign-in.

filename.description: Name for the report, e.g. bookings.csv

name: upload_report
title: Upload a report
